# opnsense_bind_record (Resource)

Records of BIND primary zones (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ Records**, plugin `os-bind`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_bind_record" "nas" {
  domain = opnsense_bind_primary_domain.home.id
  name   = "nas"
  type   = "A"
  value  = "10.0.10.20"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Select the zone for this record.
- `value` (String) Set the value for this record.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable this record. Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (String) Set the name for this record. Defaults to ``.
- `type` (String) Set the type for this record. One of `A`, `AAAA`, `CAA`, `CNAME`, `DNAME`, `DNSKEY`, `DS`, `HTTPS`, `MX`, `NAPTR`, `NS`, `PTR`, `RP`, `RRSIG`, `SRV`, `SSHFP`, `SVCB`, `TLSA`, `TXT`. Defaults to `A`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the BIND record.
